title.zh: Markdown 中的 Mermaid 图表更快

body.en: Mermaid diagrams now render with Pele instead of mermaid.js, so the app is lighter and diagrams draw faster. They follow Lattice's light and dark theme, and a diagram that can't be drawn shows a clear error. Layouts may differ slightly from before.
body.zh: Mermaid 图表现在使用 Pele 而非 mermaid.js 渲染，应用更轻巧，图表绘制更快。图表会跟随 Lattice 的浅色和深色主题，无法绘制时会显示清晰的错误提示。布局可能与之前略有不同。
